ticks.note: Deferred entry into superstate B: nothing inside B happens in this tick.

Surprise: when **all** transitions into B are deferred, KIELER enters B for real only now. The inner initial state's entry action runs now (innerEntry = 1); B's own entry action never runs (outerEntry = 0).
I's delayed transition fires (step1 = 1): one tick later than after a normal entry.
